Thread on HMPV 🦠

🦠 What is HMPV? 
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus causing symptoms similar to colds, flu, or pneumonia. It spreads via droplets from coughing, sneezing, or contact with contaminated surfaces.

#HMPV #HMP

Thread on HMPV 🦠

🦠 What is HMPV? 
Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) is a respiratory virus causing symptoms similar to colds, flu, or pneumonia. It spreads via droplets from coughing, sneezing, or contact with contaminated surfaces.

#HMPV #HMPVinIndia #HMPVCases 

[1/5]

nodes.author: imkishan95
nodes.text:
Do's:

✔️ Wash hands frequently with soap & water.
✔️ Cover mouth/nose while coughing or sneezing.
✔️ Disinfect surfaces regularly.
✔️ Stay hydrated & maintain good nutrition.

#HMPV #HMPvirus #HMPVCase 

[3/5]

nodes.author: imkishan95
nodes.text:
Don'ts:
❌ Avoid crowded places if you're unwell.
❌ Don’t share personal items like utensils/towels.
❌ Avoid smoking; it worsens symptoms.

#HMPV #hmpvvirus #HMPVinIndia #HMPVCase 

[4/5]

nodes.author: imkishan95
nodes.text:
Treatment:
No specific antiviral for HMPV.

Supportive care: Rest, fluids, fever reducers (paracetamol).

🏥 Seek medical help if symptoms worsen.

Prevent respiratory illnesses by staying informed & staying safe! #HMPV #HealthTips
#HMPVinIndia
#HMPVVirusInIndia
[5/5]
